s: Endlich hält er das rosa Nilpferd in den Armen.
At last he holds the pink hippo in his arms.
Nilpferd.et: From Nil (“Nile”) + Pferd (“horse”), a loose calque of Latin hippopotamus, from Ancient Greek ἱπποπόταμος (hippopótamos). Akin to Dutch nijlpaard.

s: Nile (a large river in Africa, usually considered to be the longest river in the world; its basin covers Burundi, Rwanda, Tanzania, Kenya, Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, Eritrea, South Sudan, Sudan, and Egypt, flowing north through Khartoum and Cairo into the Mediterranean S
a male given name from Swedish or Norwegian
der rheinländische Arzt […] am Nil […], oder der nilische Arzt an der Donau […]
Nilotic (of or pertaining to the Nilotic language family)
Suffering from a venereal disease (of a man)
